gold.user: A project manager wants to set multiple properties for a list of issues in a single API call to streamline the process.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON array of issue IDs and their corresponding properties to be set.

gold.user: A developer needs to update properties for several issues at once based on their IDs to improve efficiency.
gold.ideal: The API should allow the user to send a JSON object containing issue IDs and their properties to be updated.

gold.user: An administrator wants to remove a specific property from all issues to clean up outdated information.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a property key and delete that property from all issues where it exists.

gold.user: A team lead needs to set a common property for all issues in a project to ensure consistency.
gold.ideal: The API should allow the user to specify a property key and value to be set for all issues.

gold.user: A QA engineer wants to retrieve all property keys associated with a specific issue to understand its context.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all property keys for the specified issue.

gold.user: A product owner needs to delete a specific property from an issue that is no longer relevant.
gold.ideal: The API should remove the specified property from the given issue.

gold.user: A developer wants to check the value of a specific property on an issue to verify its status.
gold.ideal: The API should return the value of the specified property for the given issue.

gold.user: A project coordinator needs to update a property for a specific issue to reflect new information.
gold.ideal: The API should allow the user to set or update the value of a specific property for the given issue.
